    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">分享一个MySQL/MariaDB/Percona全版本root密码重置工具</span>
    

</a>

		</h2>
		<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>直接上脚本了</p>
<blockquote>
<h1 id="usrbinenv-bash">!/usr/bin/env bash</h1>
<h1 id="_">============================================================</h1>
<h1 id="mysql--mariadb--percona-全版本-root-密码重置工具">MySQL / MariaDB / Percona 全版本 root 密码重置工具</h1>
<h1 id="用法bash-reset_allsh---help">用法：bash reset_all.sh --help</h1>
<h1 id="_-1">============================================================</h1>
<p>set -uo pipefail</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>SCRIPT_NAME=$(basename "$0")<br>
SCRIPT_VERSION="2.0.0"</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<h1 id="-----------帮助-----------">---------- 帮助 ----------</h1>
<p>usage(){<br>
cat &lt;&lt;EOF<br>
${SCRIPT_NAME} ${SCRIPT_VERSION} — MySQL / MariaDB / Percona root 密码重置</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>用法：<br>
bash ${SCRIPT_NAME} [选项] &lt;新密码&gt; [my.cnf路径]</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>选项：<br>
-h, --help                显示本帮助并退出（不需要 root，不操作数据库）<br>
-V, --version             显示脚本版本并退出<br>
-c, --config &lt;路径&gt;       指定 my.cnf 路径；不指定则自动探测<br>
--password &lt;密码&gt;     指定新密码（等价于位置参数，注意会出现在 ps 输出中）<br>
--auth-plugin &lt;插件&gt;  仅 MySQL 5.7.6 ~ 8.3 生效，指定认证插件<br>
例如 mysql_native_password、caching_sha2_password<br>
--keep-network        临时阶段保留 TCP 监听（默认使用 skip-networking 关闭）<br>
--                    结束选项解析，其后全部按位置参数处理</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>环境变量：<br>
NO_SKIP_NETWORKING=1      等价于 --keep-network<br>
AUTH_PLUGIN=&lt;插件名&gt;      等价于 --auth-plugin<br>
MYSQL_NEW_PASS=&lt;密码&gt;     通过环境变量传入新密码，避免出现在命令历史中</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>版本兼容：<br>
MySQL     4.1 ~ 5.6       SET PASSWORD ... = PASSWORD()，权限表字段 Password<br>
MySQL     5.7.0 ~ 5.7.5   SET PASSWORD ... = PASSWORD()，权限表字段 Password<br>
MySQL     5.7.6 ~ 5.7.x   ALTER USER ... IDENTIFIED BY，字段 authentication_string<br>
MySQL     8.0 ~ 8.3       ALTER USER ... IDENTIFIED BY，默认 caching_sha2_password<br>
MySQL     8.4 ~ 9.x       ALTER USER ... IDENTIFIED BY，mysql_native_password 已移除<br>
MariaDB   5.5 ~ 10.1      SET PASSWORD ... = PASSWORD()，字段 Password<br>
MariaDB   10.2 ~ 10.3     ALTER USER ... IDENTIFIED BY，字段 Password<br>
MariaDB   10.4 ~ 11.x     ALTER USER / SET PASSWORD，mysql.user 已为视图</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>执行前提：</p>
<ol>
<li>必须以操作系统 root 执行（--help / --version 除外）</li>
<li>必须处于维护窗口，脚本会停止并重启数据库实例两次</li>
<li>建议先完成数据与配置备份</li>
<li>实例若处于复制链路，改密会写入 binlog 并向下游传播</li>
</ol>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>工作原理：<br>
停止实例 → 以 skip-grant-tables 启动 → 在同一个连接内先 FLUSH PRIVILEGES<br>
再执行改密语句 → 还原配置并正常重启 → 用新密码验证登录</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>注意：FLUSH PRIVILEGES 会重新加载 ACL 并恢复密码校验，因此改密语句<br>
必须与该命令在同一连接内完成；分连接执行会导致后续连接返回 ERROR 1045。</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>退出码：<br>
0  改密成功且新密码验证通过<br>
1  执行失败（连接失败、改密失败、验证失败等）<br>
2  参数用法错误</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>示例：<br>
查看帮助<br>
bash ${SCRIPT_NAME} --help</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>最简用法（自动探测配置、socket、端口）<br>
bash ${SCRIPT_NAME} 'MyN3wP@ss'</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>指定配置文件<br>
bash ${SCRIPT_NAME} -c /etc/my.cnf 'MyN3wP@ss'</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>MySQL 8.0 需要兼容老客户端<br>
bash ${SCRIPT_NAME} --auth-plugin mysql_native_password 'MyN3wP@ss'</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>临时阶段保留网络监听<br>
bash ${SCRIPT_NAME} --keep-network 'MyN3wP@ss'</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>通过环境变量传密码（推荐，避免进入命令历史）<br>
MYSQL_NEW_PASS='MyN3wP@ss' bash $</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>安全提示：<br>
使用 --password 或位置参数时，密码会出现在 ps 与 shell 历史中；<br>
生产环境建议改用 MYSQL_NEW_PASS 环境变量，并在执行后清理历史。<br>
EOF<br>
}</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>err(){  echo "[错误] $<em>" &gt;&amp;2; }<br>
info(){ echo "[信息] $</em>"; }<br>
warn()</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<h1 id="-----------参数解析-----------">---------- 参数解析 ----------</h1>
<p>NEW_PASS="${MYSQL_NEW_PASS:-}"<br>
CONF=""<br>
AUTH_PLUGIN="${AUTH_PLUGIN:-}"<br>
KEEP_NET=0</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do<br>
case "$1" in<br>
-h|--help)        usage; exit 0 ;;<br>
-V|--version)     echo "${SCRIPT_NAME} ${SCRIPT_VERSION}"; exit 0 ;;<br>
-c|--config)<br>
[ $# -ge 2 ] || { err "选项 $1 需要参数"; exit 2; }<br>
CONF="$2"; shift 2 ;;<br>
--config=<em>)       CONF="${1#</em>=}"; shift ;;<br>
--password)<br>
[ $# -ge 2 ] || { err "选项 $1 需要参数"; exit 2; }<br>
NEW_PASS="$2"; shift 2 ;;<br>
--password=<em>)     NEW_PASS="${1#</em>=}"; shift ;;<br>
--auth-plugin)<br>
[ $# -ge 2 ] || { err "选项 $1 需要参数"; exit 2; }<br>
AUTH_PLUGIN="$2"; shift 2 ;;<br>
--auth-plugin=<em>)  AUTH_PLUGIN="${1#</em>=}"; shift ;;<br>
--keep-network)   KEEP_NET=1; shift ;;<br>
--)               shift; break ;;<br>
-*)               err "未知选项：$1"; echo "使用 ${SCRIPT_NAME} --help 查看帮助" &gt;&amp;2; exit 2 ;;<br>
*)<br>
if [ -z "$NEW_PASS" ]; then NEW_PASS="$1"<br>
elif [ -z "$CONF" ];    then CONF="$1"<br>
else err "多余的参数：$1"; echo "使用 ${SCRIPT_NAME} --help 查看帮助" &gt;&amp;2; exit 2<br>
fi<br>
shift ;;<br>
esac<br>
done</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do<br>
if [ -z "$NEW_PASS" ]; then NEW_PASS="$1"<br>
elif [ -z "$CONF" ];    then CONF="$1"<br>
else err "多余的参数：$1"; exit 2<br>
fi<br>
shift<br>
done</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>if [ -z "$NEW_PASS" ]; then<br>
err "缺少新密码参数"<br>
echo "用法：bash ${SCRIPT_NAME} [选项] &lt;新密码&gt; [my.cnf路径]" &gt;&amp;2<br>
echo "帮助：bash ${SCRIPT_NAME} --help" &gt;&amp;2<br>
exit 2<br>
fi</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote 1;="">
<p>[ "$(id -u)" -ne 0 ] &amp;&amp;</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>case "$NEW_PASS" in<br>
<em>"'"</em>|<em>"\"</em>) err "密码不能包含单引号或反斜杠"; exit 2 ;;<br>
esac</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<h1 id="-----------1-定位配置文件-----------">---------- 1. 定位配置文件 ----------</h1>
<p>if [ -z "$CONF" ]; then<br>
for f in /etc/my.cnf /etc/mysql/my.cnf /etc/mysql/mysql.conf.d/mysqld.cnf <br>
/usr/local/mysql/etc/my.cnf /usr/local/mysql/my.cnf; do<br>
[ -f "$f" ] &amp;&amp; CONF="$f" &amp;&amp; break<br>
done<br>
fi<br>
if [ -z "$CONF" ] || [ ! -f "$CONF" ]; then<br>
err "未找到配置文件，请用 -c 指定"<br>
exit 1<br>
fi<br>
info "配置文件：$CONF"</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<h1 id="-----------2-定位-mysql-客户端-----------">---------- 2. 定位 mysql 客户端 ----------</h1>
<p>MYSQL_BIN=""<br>
for p in "$(command -v mysql 2&gt;/dev/null)" <br>
/usr/local/mysql/bin/mysql /usr/bin/mysql /usr/local/bin/mysql; do<br>
[ -n "$p" ] &amp;&amp; [ -x "$p" ] &amp;&amp; MYSQL_BIN="$p" &amp;&amp; break<br>
done<br>
[ -z "$MYSQL_BIN" ] &amp;&amp; { err "未找到 mysql 客户端"; exit 1; }<br>
info "客户端：$MYSQL_BIN"</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<h1 id="-----------3-推导-socket--port-候选-----------">---------- 3. 推导 socket / port 候选 ----------</h1>
<p>SOCK_CANDS=""; PORT_CANDS=""<br>
MPD=$(command -v my_print_defaults 2&gt;/dev/null || true)<br>
if [ -n "$MPD" ]; then<br>
DEFAULTS=$("$MPD" --defaults-file="$CONF" mysqld client 2&gt;/dev/null || true)<br>
s=$(printf '%s\n' "$DEFAULTS" | awk -F= '/^--socket=/{v=$2} END{print v}')<br>
p=$(printf '%s\n' "$DEFAULTS" | awk -F= '/^--port=/{v=$2} END{print v}')<br>
[ -n "$s" ] &amp;&amp; SOCK_CANDS="$s"<br>
[ -n "$p" ] &amp;&amp; PORT_CANDS="$p"<br>
fi<br>
for s in /tmp/mysql.sock /var/lib/mysql/mysql.sock /run/mysqld/mysqld.sock <br>
/var/run/mysqld/mysqld.sock /usr/local/mysql/data/mysql.sock; do<br>
SOCK_CANDS="$SOCK_CANDS $s"<br>
done<br>
s=$(ps -ef 2&gt;/dev/null | grep -oE -- '--socket=[^ ]+' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)<br>
[ -n "$s" ] &amp;&amp; SOCK_CANDS="$s $SOCK_CANDS"<br>
for p in 3306 23306 3307 3308; do PORT_CANDS="$PORT_CANDS $p"; done</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<h1 id="-----------4-识别服务管理方式-----------">---------- 4. 识别服务管理方式 ----------</h1>
<p>SVC_KIND=""; SVC_NAME=""<br>
if command -v systemctl &gt;/dev/null 2&gt;&amp;1; then<br>
for s in mysqld mysql mariadb; do<br>
if systemctl list-unit-files 2&gt;/dev/null | grep -q "^${s}.service"; then<br>
SVC_KIND="systemd"; SVC_NAME="$s"; break<br>
fi<br>
done<br>
fi<br>
if [ -z "$SVC_KIND" ]; then<br>
for s in mysql mysqld mariadb; do<br>
if [ -x "/etc/init.d/$s" ]; then<br>
SVC_KIND="sysv"; SVC_NAME="$s"; break<br>
fi<br>
done<br>
fi<br>
[ -z "$SVC_KIND" ] &amp;&amp; SVC_KIND="mysqld_safe"<br>
info "服务管理：$SVC_KIND ${SVC_NAME:-无}"</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote -uroot="" --connect-timeout="10">
<h1 id="-----------5-连接探测与服务控制-----------">---------- 5. 连接探测与服务控制 ----------</h1>
<p>CONN_OPTS=""; CONN_DESC=""<br>
sql()</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>probe(){<br>
local s p<br>
for s in $SOCK_CANDS; do<br>
[ -S "$s" ] || continue<br>
if "$MYSQL_BIN" --socket="$s" -uroot --connect-timeout=5 <br>
-e "SELECT 1" &gt;/dev/null 2&gt;&amp;1; then<br>
CONN_OPTS="--socket=$s"; CONN_DESC="socket=$s"; return 0<br>
fi<br>
done<br>
for p in $PORT_CANDS; do<br>
if "$MYSQL_BIN" -h127.0.0.1 -P"$p" -uroot --connect-timeout=5 <br>
-e "SELECT 1" &gt;/dev/null 2&gt;&amp;1; then<br>
CONN_OPTS="-h127.0.0.1 -P$p"; CONN_DESC="tcp=127.0.0.1:$p"; return 0<br>
fi<br>
done<br>
return 1<br>
}</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>wait_ready(){<br>
local i<br>
for i in $(seq 1 60); do probe &amp;&amp; return 0; sleep 2; done<br>
return 1<br>
}</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>start_normal(){<br>
case "$SVC_KIND" in<br>
systemd) systemctl start "$SVC_NAME" ;;<br>
sysv)    "/etc/init.d/$SVC_NAME" start ;;<br>
*)<br>
local ms<br>
ms=$(command -v mysqld_safe 2&gt;/dev/null || echo /usr/local/mysql/bin/mysqld_safe)<br>
nohup "$ms" &gt;/tmp/mysql_reset_safe.log 2&gt;&amp;1 &amp;<br>
;;<br>
esac<br>
}</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>start_skip(){<br>
case "$SVC_KIND" in<br>
systemd) systemctl start "$SVC_NAME" ;;<br>
sysv)    "/etc/init.d/$SVC_NAME" start ;;<br>
*)<br>
local ms<br>
ms=$(command -v mysqld_safe 2&gt;/dev/null || echo /usr/local/mysql/bin/mysqld_safe)<br>
nohup "$ms" --skip-grant-tables $SKIP_NET &gt;/tmp/mysql_reset_safe.log 2&gt;&amp;1 &amp;<br>
;;<br>
esac<br>
}</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>stop_db(){<br>
case "$SVC_KIND" in<br>
systemd) systemctl stop "$SVC_NAME" ;;<br>
sysv)    "/etc/init.d/$SVC_NAME" stop ;;<br>
*)<br>
sql -e "SHUTDOWN;" &gt;/dev/null 2&gt;&amp;1<br>
sleep 3<br>
if command -v pkill &gt;/dev/null 2&gt;&amp;1; then<br>
pkill -f mysqld_safe &gt;/dev/null 2&gt;&amp;1<br>
pkill -f '[m]ysqld ' &gt;/dev/null 2&gt;&amp;1<br>
fi<br>
sleep 2<br>
;;<br>
esac<br>
}</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<h1 id="-----------6-备份与回滚-----------">---------- 6. 备份与回滚 ----------</h1>
<p>BK="${CONF}.bak.$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)"<br>
cp -a "$CONF" "$BK" || { err "备份配置失败"; exit 1; }<br>
info "配置已备份：$BK"</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>RESTORED=0<br>
restore_cfg(){<br>
[ "$RESTORED" -eq 1 ] &amp;&amp; return 0<br>
RESTORED=1<br>
info "停止实例并还原配置..."<br>
stop_db<br>
sleep 2<br>
cp -a "$BK" "$CONF"<br>
start_normal<br>
info "配置已还原：$CONF"<br>
}<br>
trap 'restore_cfg; exit 1' INT TERM</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<h1 id="-----------7-进入跳过权限校验模式-----------">---------- 7. 进入跳过权限校验模式 ----------</h1>
<p>SKIP_NET=""<br>
[ "$KEEP_NET" -ne 1 ] &amp;&amp; [ "${NO_SKIP_NETWORKING:-0}" != "1" ] &amp;&amp; SKIP_NET="--skip-networking"</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>info "停止数据库..."<br>
stop_db<br>
sleep 3</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>if [ "$SVC_KIND" != "mysqld_safe" ]; then<br>
{<br>
echo ""<br>
echo "[mysqld]"<br>
echo "skip-grant-tables"<br>
[ -n "$SKIP_NET" ] &amp;&amp; echo "skip-networking"<br>
} &gt;&gt; "$CONF"<br>
fi</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>info "以跳过权限校验方式启动..."<br>
start_skip</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>if ! wait_ready; then<br>
err "120 秒内无法连接，请查看错误日志"<br>
restore_cfg<br>
exit 1<br>
fi<br>
info "已连接：$CONN_DESC"</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<h1 id="-----------8-识别版本与分支-----------">---------- 8. 识别版本与分支 ----------</h1>
<p>VER_RAW=$(sql -N -B -e "SELECT VERSION();" 2&gt;/dev/null)<br>
if [ -z "$VER_RAW" ]; then<br>
err "获取版本失败"<br>
restore_cfg<br>
exit 1<br>
fi<br>
info "版本：$VER_RAW"</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>case "$VER_RAW" in<br>
<em>MariaDB</em>) FLAVOR="mariadb" ;;<br>
*)         FLAVOR="mysql" ;;<br>
esac</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>NUM=$(printf '%s\n' "$VER_RAW" | sed 's/^5.5.5-//' <br>
| grep -oE '[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+' | head -1)<br>
MAJOR=${NUM%%.<em>}; R=${NUM#</em>.}; MINOR=${R%%.<em>}; PATCH=${R#</em>.}<br>
MAJOR=${MAJOR:-0}; MINOR=${MINOR:-0}; PATCH=${PATCH:-0}<br>
info "识别：$FLAVOR $MAJOR.$MINOR.$PATCH"</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>ver_ge(){<br>
[ "$MAJOR" -gt "$1" ] &amp;&amp; return 0<br>
[ "$MAJOR" -lt "$1" ] &amp;&amp; return 1<br>
[ "$MINOR" -gt "$2" ] &amp;&amp; return 0<br>
[ "$MINOR" -lt "$2" ] &amp;&amp; return 1<br>
[ "$PATCH" -ge "$3" ] &amp;&amp; return 0<br>
return 1<br>
}</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<h1 id="-----------9-读取账号与运行态-----------">---------- 9. 读取账号与运行态 ----------</h1>
<p>USERS=$(sql -N -B -e "SELECT CONCAT(user,'@',host) FROM mysql.user WHERE user='root';" 2&gt;/dev/null)<br>
CREATE_ROOT=0<br>
if [ -z "$USERS" ]; then<br>
warn "未查到 root 账号，将创建 root@localhost"<br>
CREATE_ROOT=1<br>
else<br>
info "待重置账号：$(printf '%s\n' "$USERS" | tr '\n' ' ')"<br>
fi</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>RO_FIX=""<br>
ROV=$(sql -N -B -e "SELECT @@global.read_only;" 2&gt;/dev/null)<br>
[ "$ROV" = "1" ] &amp;&amp; RO_FIX="$RO_FIX SET GLOBAL read_only=OFF;"<br>
SROV=$(sql -N -B -e "SELECT @@global.super_read_only;" 2&gt;/dev/null)<br>
[ "$SROV" = "1" ] &amp;&amp; RO_FIX="$RO_FIX SET GLOBAL super_read_only=OFF;"</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>PW_RELAX=""<br>
if [ "$FLAVOR" = "mysql" ]; then<br>
if ver_ge 8 0 0; then<br>
COMP=$(sql -N -B -e "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mysql.component WHERE component_urn LIKE '%validate_password%';" 2&gt;/dev/null)<br>
if [ "${COMP:-0}" -gt 0 ] 2&gt;/dev/null; then<br>
PW_RELAX="SET GLOBAL validate_password.policy=LOW; SET GLOBAL validate_password.length=4;"<br>
fi<br>
elif ver_ge 5 7 0; then<br>
VP=$(sql -N -B -e "SHOW VARIABLES LIKE 'validate_password_policy';" 2&gt;/dev/null)<br>
[ -n "$VP" ] &amp;&amp; PW_RELAX="SET GLOBAL validate_password_policy=LOW; SET GLOBAL validate_password_length=4;"<br>
fi<br>
fi</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<h1 id="-----------10-按版本生成改密语句-----------">---------- 10. 按版本生成改密语句 ----------</h1>
<p>make_stmt(){<br>
local u="${1%@<em>}" h="${1#</em>@}"<br>
if [ "$FLAVOR" = "mariadb" ]; then<br>
if ver_ge 10 2 0; then<br>
echo "ALTER USER '$u'@'$h' IDENTIFIED BY '$NEW_PASS';"<br>
else<br>
echo "SET PASSWORD FOR '$u'@'$h' = PASSWORD('$NEW_PASS');"<br>
fi<br>
else<br>
if ver_ge 5 7 6; then<br>
if [ -n "$AUTH_PLUGIN" ]; then<br>
echo "ALTER USER '$u'@'$h' IDENTIFIED WITH $AUTH_PLUGIN BY '$NEW_PASS';"<br>
else<br>
echo "ALTER USER '$u'@'$h' IDENTIFIED BY '$NEW_PASS';"<br>
fi<br>
else<br>
echo "SET PASSWORD FOR '$u'@'$h' = PASSWORD('$NEW_PASS');"<br>
fi<br>
fi<br>
}</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<h1 id="-----------11-单连接执行关键-----------">---------- 11. 单连接执行（关键） ----------</h1>
<p>OUT=$(<br>
{<br>
echo "FLUSH PRIVILEGES;"<br>
[ -n "$RO_FIX" ]   &amp;&amp; echo "$RO_FIX"<br>
[ -n "$PW_RELAX" ] &amp;&amp; echo "$PW_RELAX"<br>
if [ "$CREATE_ROOT" -eq 1 ]; then<br>
if [ "$FLAVOR" = "mysql" ] &amp;&amp; ver_ge 8 0 0; then<br>
echo "CREATE USER 'root'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY '$NEW_PASS';"<br>
echo "GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON <em>.</em> TO 'root'@'localhost' WITH GRANT OPTION;"<br>
else<br>
echo "GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON <em>.</em> TO 'root'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY '$NEW_PASS' WITH GRANT OPTION;"<br>
fi<br>
else<br>
for uh in $USERS; do make_stmt "$uh"; done<br>
fi<br>
echo "FLUSH PRIVILEGES;"<br>
} | sql --force 2&gt;&amp;1<br>
)<br>
[ -n "$OUT" ] &amp;&amp; printf '%s\n' "$OUT"</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>FAILED=0<br>
case "$OUT" in <em>"ERROR"</em>) FAILED=1 ;; esac</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<h1 id="-----------12-老版本兜底-----------">---------- 12. 老版本兜底 ----------</h1>
<p>if [ "$FAILED" -eq 1 ] &amp;&amp; [ "$CREATE_ROOT" -eq 0 ]; then<br>
if [ "$FLAVOR" = "mysql" ] &amp;&amp; ver_ge 5 7 6; then<br>
warn "标准语句失败，请按上面的 ERROR 处理（多为密码策略校验，可改用更强密码）"<br>
else<br>
warn "标准语句失败，改为直接更新权限表..."<br>
{<br>
for uh in $USERS; do<br>
u="${uh%@<em>}"; h="${uh#</em>@}"<br>
if [ "$FLAVOR" = "mariadb" ] &amp;&amp; ver_ge 10 4 0; then<br>
echo "SET PASSWORD FOR '$u'@'$h' = PASSWORD('$NEW_PASS');"<br>
else<br>
echo "UPDATE mysql.user SET Password=PASSWORD('$NEW_PASS') WHERE user='$u' AND host='$h';"<br>
fi<br>
done<br>
echo "FLUSH PRIVILEGES;"<br>
} | sql --force 2&gt;&amp;1<br>
fi<br>
fi</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<h1 id="-----------13-还原并验证-----------">---------- 13. 还原并验证 ----------</h1>
<p>info "还原配置并重启..."<br>
restore_cfg<br>
trap - INT TERM</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>info "等待实例就绪..."<br>
i=0<br>
while [ "$i" -lt 60 ]; do<br>
MYSQL_PWD="$NEW_PASS" "$MYSQL_BIN" $CONN_OPTS -uroot <br>
--connect-timeout=5 -e "SELECT 1" &gt;/dev/null 2&gt;&amp;1 &amp;&amp; break<br>
i=$((i+1)); sleep 2<br>
done</p>
</blockquote>
<blockquote>
<p>if MYSQL_PWD="$NEW_PASS" "$MYSQL_BIN" $CONN_OPTS -uroot <br>
--connect-timeout=5 -e "SELECT 1" &gt;/dev/null 2&gt;&amp;1; then<br>
info "完成：新密码验证通过"<br>
exit 0<br>
else<br>
warn "新密码验证失败，请检查错误日志与上面的输出"<br>
warn "配置备份：$BK"<br>
exit 1<br>
fi</p>
</blockquote>
<p>使用示例</p>
<blockquote>
<p>bash reset_all.sh --help<br>
bash reset_all.sh -V<br>
bash reset_all.sh -c /etc/my.cnf 'MyN3wP@ss'<br>
MYSQL_NEW_PASS='MyN3wP@ss' bash reset_all.sh</p>
</blockquote>
